$comment: Every deployable Lambda, in one place. Two things read this file and must
never disagree:
.github/workflows/deploy-lambdas.yml   — builds and ships each function
scripts/check-lambda-drift.py          — asks whether AWS runs what main says
Why it exists. Deploying used to mean hand-copying a whole workflow file
per function, each with its own hardcoded `paths:` filter. Only 2 of the 7
deployable functions ever got one, so the rest could only be deployed by
hand -- and the membership registry duly sat 38 lines behind main until
2026-09-17. Separately, the drift checker carried its own hand-maintained
map of function -> source file, which is the SAME fact as `target_filename`
below, written down twice and free to rot.
Adding a function is now one entry here. Nothing else.
Fields:
function_name    exact AWS Lambda name (us-west-1, account 043206426879)
source_file      file under lambda-functions/ that is the truth
target_filename  what that file is called INSIDE the zip. Several
functions were deployed with the entry renamed to the
CDK default lambda_function.py; that rename is a deploy
fact, so it lives here and the drift checker derives it.
handler          must equal '<target_filename minus .py>.lambda_handler'
runtime          python3.9 / python3.11 -- must match what AWS has
architecture     x86_64 / arm64 -- must match what AWS has
deps             space-separated pip packages VENDORED INTO THE ZIP.
Empty when the dependency arrives via a layer instead.
Getting this wrong is not cosmetic: on 2026-04-07 five
functions were overwritten with source-only zips and
every generator 5xx'd for 12 days.
stub_pil         reportlab imports PIL; the stub keeps the zip small
layer            informational. update-function-code does not touch
layers, so this records what the function relies on
being attached. The smoke test catches it if it is not.
verified         when a human last confirmed this row against live AWS

not_deployed.$comment: Listed so a report can say 'out of scope, because X' instead of silently skipping something that might matter. Keyed by AWS function name where one exists, otherwise by source file.
not_deployed.AirtableFieldsStack-EnsureAirtableFields: Live and in use, but deliberately NOT auto-deployed: its 95 KB zip is a CDK bundle carrying six handler files, and this workflow builds a fresh zip from one source file, which would drop the other five. Deploy via CDK, or move it to its own zip first.
